body.name: average-design convex borrowing frontier
body.construction: For every \(0\le\gamma\le\Gamma_{\mathrm{vac}}\), minimize \(\Psi_{\alpha,\gamma}(v)=\mathsf B_\gamma(v)+\sqrt{\overline{\mathsf V}_{\mathcal D,\gamma}(v)/\alpha}\) over \(v\in\Delta(\mathcal B)\), select \(v_\gamma^\star\) from the argmin, and set \(\mathfrak R_{\alpha,\gamma}^\star=\min\{2M,\Psi_{\alpha,\gamma}(v_\gamma^\star)\}\). The fixed-budget objects are \(\Psi_\alpha=\Psi_{\alpha,\Gamma}\), \(v^\star=v_\Gamma^\star\), and \(\mathfrak R_\alpha^\star=\mathfrak R_{\alpha,\Gamma}^\star\).
